notes: Reader: GPT-6 Astra Pro, effort not exposed, run SP84_C13_149. This is a first reading of scan019 only, using its own packet and images. The whole image and both prepared halves were inspected once; every agreed word, abbreviation, sign and index was read against the ink before the mandatory/open-place crops.

Line accounting: 24 main body rows, including the separate crossed un ss-groupe line; four raised insertion groups (K, fixée/fixe, et ... Gamma, k); the isolated upper cancelled number; five rotated marginal rows; and the author number and foliation give 36 inspected rows. The overwritten digit under the live 3 shares that row and is not counted again.

S019.1 — The page says that several essentially equivalent profinite descriptions of a finite-type extension K of Q are available. Its five main items name an étale topos, a fundamental groupoid, an exterior group, data using an algebraic closure of K, and data using a fixed algebraic closure of Q. This records the author’s assertion; it is not a proof check of the claimed equivalences.

S019.2 — A sixth description is written vertically in the left margin. It names the abbreviated gr.-oïde/gr.-oïdes and the topos quotient after tensoring K with Q-bar, with the indicated Gamma action; its parenthesis explicitly says pas néc. connexe. The full note has five rows when rotated clockwise.

S019.3 — The relation in the last main paragraph is preserved as pi_K unsure{neq|=|simeq} pi_1(K). Its additional curved ink does not cleanly cross the upper bar, and the slight wave also permits the similarity-sign alternative. No mathematical expectation was used to choose among these readings.

The literal article sequence de le is retained without grammatical repair; the following clôture/cloture accent remains uncertain. The opening word before extension retains une/d’une/des alternatives and uncertain cancellation state; the raised K attaches after extension. The source also has the short forms pts, rev., pro-gr, hom, ss-, alg. and néc.; they are not expanded in the transcription.

The upper crossed 2) and the uncertain old 2 beneath the live 3 are distinct physical corrections. In item 5, the raised replacement equation sits above the cancelled par le groupe, and the later par before considérant is separately crossed. The leaders belonging to fixée/fixe and k are attachment strokes, not extra cancellations.

The author’s page number is 9 at the head. Thin smaller 18 at the lower left is separate foliation in another hand. Neither the archive scan number 19 nor H’s editorial explanatory notes are manuscript prose.

The only prelisted mark M1010 remains undecided. The C-only doubtful crossed comme now retains comme/connexe/connexes alternatives. Other localized doubts include the opening word and its cancellation state, ce/en, the compressed au-dessus/dash-disons/dash-dessus phrase, the old numeral under 3, item-4 punctuation and map endpoint, fixée/fixe, the tiny si, clôture/cloture, the three-way pi relation, and the marginal abbreviation, accent and punctuation. No formula was completed from mathematical context.

Crop c15 was initially found to clip the final row of the still-unresolved vertical note. The same crop file was extended to [0,1000,430,2290] before the full marginal reading was settled; this is the sole saved version. Agreed pen numerals have coordinate-only audit boxes unless a witness omission or actual correction required a crop.
No mathematical proof, refutation, computation or background-use check was performed for this reader return; checks is intentionally empty.

S019.1 — The page says that several essentially equivalent profinite descriptions of a finite-type extension K of Q are available. Its five main items name an étale topos, a fundamental groupoid, an exterior group, data using an algebraic closure of K, and data using a fixed algebraic closure of Q. This records the author’s assertion; it is not a proof check of the claimed equivalences.

It names the abbreviated gr.-oïde/gr.-oïdes and the topos quotient after tensoring K with Q-bar, with the indicated Gamma action; its parenthesis explicitly says pas néc. connexe.
